cvnp.name: Cuyahoga Valley National Park
cvnp.description: Make a day of waterfall overlooks, forest trails and the Ohio & Erie Canal Towpath. Brandywine Falls is a memorable place to start.

stan.name: Stan Hywet Hall & Gardens
stan.description: Tour the Tudor Revival manor and wander the landscaped gardens. Check the estate’s seasonal calendar for tours and special events.

zoo.name: Akron Zoo
zoo.description: Meet wildlife from around the world and explore habitats designed for an easy family day out. Check admission and seasonal experiences before visiting.

kent.name: Kent State University Museum
kent.description: Discover fashion, textiles and decorative arts in a university museum with changing exhibitions. A thoughtful indoor stop for a day in Kent.

art.name: Akron Art Museum
art.description: Explore modern and contemporary art, changing exhibitions and the museum’s striking architecture. Pair a gallery visit with a walk around downtown.

maps.name: MAPS Air Museum
maps.description: See historic aircraft up close, explore aviation exhibits and learn the stories behind them. An engaging stop near Akron-Canton Airport.

hof.name: Pro Football Hall of Fame
hof.description: Step inside football history, explore the Hall of Fame Gallery and discover the players and moments that shaped the game.

mckinley.name: McKinley Presidential Library & Museum
mckinley.description: Combine presidential history, local heritage and hands-on science in one visit. Check the museum’s current programs and planetarium schedule.

canton-art.name: Canton Museum of Art
canton-art.description: Browse changing exhibitions and a collection known for American works on paper and ceramics. Look for classes and special programs during your stay.

blue-door.name: The Blue Door Café & Bakery
blue-door.description: Make time for a leisurely brunch, baked goods or dinner at this State Road café. Browse the current menu and reserve ahead for your visit.

cafe.name: The Café in Stow
cafe.description: A relaxed neighborhood stop for traditional American comfort food, from breakfast favorites to a casual meal later in the day.

crave.name: Crave on Front
crave.description: Explore inventive comfort food, sandwiches and entrées on Front Street. A convenient dinner stop before an evening around downtown Cuyahoga Falls.

swensons.name: Swensons Drive-In
swensons.description: Try a Northeast Ohio drive-in tradition with burgers, sides and shakes served to your car. Check the Stow location’s menu before heading over.

beau.name: Beau’s on the River
beau.description: Settle in for a meal overlooking the Cuyahoga River at Sheraton Suites. Check the restaurant’s current menus and reservation options.

butcher.name: Butcher & Sprout
butcher.description: A Front Street option for a meal or brunch, with a farm-to-table approach. Browse the menu and make it part of a downtown outing.

twisted.name: The Twisted Olive
twisted.description: Enjoy pizza, pasta and signature entrées in a scenic setting with several dining spaces. Check seasonal patio availability and reserve a table.

brix.name: 35° Brix
brix.description: A locally owned kitchen with made-from-scratch dishes, a dining room, patio and full-service bar. Browse the current menu and reservation options.

bistro.name: The Bistro of Green
bistro.description: Plan a relaxed dinner at this locally owned bistro. Explore the current food and wine selections, and check availability before you go.

caston.name: Caston & Main Brew Yard
caston.description: A casual stop for a meal and a drink around Portage Lakes. Check the current menu and what’s happening at the brew yard.

gervasi.name: The Bistro at Gervasi Vineyard
gervasi.description: Dine in a restored barn on the Gervasi estate, with Italian cuisine and wines to explore. A lovely option for a celebratory evening.

ninety-one.name: 91 Wood Fired Oven
ninety-one.description: Enjoy seasonal dishes in an inviting, upscale-casual setting. Choose the North Canton or Jackson Township location for menus and reservations.

table-six.name: Table Six Kitchen + Bar
table-six.description: Meet over shareable plates and drinks at this local kitchen and bar. An easy choice for a relaxed dinner with friends or family.

aladdins.name: Aladdin’s Eatery
aladdins.description: Find Lebanese-American favorites, including hummus, salads and pita wraps. Check the North Canton location for its current menu and hours.

silver.name: Silver Springs Park
silver.description: Spend an easy afternoon around Heritage Lake, picnic areas and the playground. Bring the family for fresh air and room to explore.

fox.name: Fox Den Golf Course
fox.description: Fit a round of golf into your stay at Stow’s public course. Check tee times and course details before making your plans.

munroe.name: Munroe Falls Metro Park
munroe.description: Explore wooded trails and open landscapes just beyond Stow. Review the park map and current trail alerts to choose your route.

downtown.name: Downtown Cuyahoga Falls
downtown.description: Stroll Front Street, browse independent shops and stop for coffee or a treat. Check downtown’s calendar for markets and seasonal happenings.

workz.name: The Workz
workz.description: Head to the historic Falls Theater for arcade games, duckpin bowling and live entertainment. Check current hours and the event lineup before visiting.

cascade.name: Cascade Valley Metro Park
cascade.description: Choose a walk through the Cuyahoga River valley or visit the Overlook Area for sweeping views. Check park alerts for access updates.

blossom.name: Blossom Music Center
blossom.description: Plan an evening of music at the outdoor amphitheater, home to The Cleveland Orchestra’s summer season. Check tickets, parking and the event schedule.

portage.name: Explore Portage Lakes
portage.description: Spend time by the water, discover lakeside dining and plan a boating or fishing outing. Check individual operators for seasonal availability and rentals.

nimisila.name: Nimisila Reservoir Metro Park
nimisila.description: Look for waterbirds, enjoy shoreline views or plan a paddle on the reservoir. Check current access notices and bring the equipment your outing needs.

firestone.name: Firestone Metro Park
firestone.description: Take a break outdoors with wooded trails, wetlands and picnic areas. Use the park map and current alerts to plan your visit.

lock3.name: Lock 3 Park
lock3.description: Explore Akron’s downtown gathering place and its seasonal entertainment. Look up the current calendar for concerts, community events and winter activities.

sippo.name: Sippo Lake Park
sippo.description: Walk wooded trails, enjoy the lake and explore the park’s nature offerings. Seasonal paddling rentals make this a great warm-weather outing.

belden.name: Belden Village Mall
belden.description: Browse national retailers and local shops, grab a bite and explore entertainment options. Check the directory for individual store and restaurant hours.

palace.name: Canton Palace Theatre
palace.description: Catch a film, concert or special performance inside Canton’s historic theater. See what’s playing and reserve your tickets directly with the venue.

jackson.name: Jackson Bog State Nature Preserve
jackson.description: Explore an unusual wetland landscape along designated trails and boardwalks. Check preserve rules before visiting; pets are not permitted.
